about.description:
chromedriver-py ships the ChromeDriver executable and exposes its
location as chromedriver_py.binary_path, so Selenium and other WebDriver
clients can find it without a separate download step or a PATH entry.
The driver version tracks the Chrome release it was built for.
about.summary: ChromeDriver binary for automated testing of web apps

tests.script: python -c "import os, chromedriver_py; p = chromedriver_py.binary_path; assert os.path.isfile(p), p; assert os.access(p, os.X_OK), p; assert b'${{ version }}' in open(p, 'rb').read(), p"

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "156.0.8078.73"

package:
  name: chromedriver-py
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/c/chromedriver-py/chromedriver_py-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 38cccd306157a8cba0c30e6dc03560490bd7e59457ebbdb3030579826ff5c0bf
  - if: host_platform == "linux-64"
    then:
      url: https://storage.googleapis.com/chrome-for-testing-public/${{ version }}/linux64/chromedriver-linux64.zip
      sha256: 7b168a60f0e27f74dd13cc51a66f4f48c5046d1108280e3d77bb5af873c0c8a6
      target_directory: chromedriver-dist
  - if: host_platform == "osx-64"
    then:
      url: https://storage.googleapis.com/chrome-for-testing-public/${{ version }}/mac-x64/chromedriver-mac-x64.zip
      sha256: 447f5d7f4bc33b84db6b6e1da7c637802acfd91bee6bce9cbaf797e31dc67956
      target_directory: chromedriver-dist
  - if: host_platform == "osx-arm64"
    then:
      url: https://storage.googleapis.com/chrome-for-testing-public/${{ version }}/mac-arm64/chromedriver-mac-arm64.zip
      sha256: abb23cd13ac8d39201dd7f78a81941c4dbb6af008dc1245dc30ec04e879b3f41
      target_directory: chromedriver-dist
  - if: host_platform == "win-64"
    then:
      url: https://storage.googleapis.com/chrome-for-testing-public/${{ version }}/win64/chromedriver-win64.zip
      sha256: f782a94fc2a16e7dc6be48c6a18516dc708de8e86ff4a736ddc3ff62ff207ebf
      target_directory: chromedriver-dist

build:
  number: 0
  skip: not (linux and x86_64) and not osx and not (win and x86_64)
  dynamic_linking:
    binary_relocation: ${{ not osx }}
  python:
    version_independent: true
  script:
    - ${{ PYTHON }} ${{ RECIPE_DIR }}/prepare.py ${{ host_platform }}
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - chromedriver_py
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - script:
      - python -c "import os, chromedriver_py; p = chromedriver_py.binary_path; assert os.path.isfile(p), p; assert os.access(p, os.X_OK), p; assert b'${{ version }}' in open(p, 'rb').read(), p"
    requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/breuerfelix/chromedriver-py
  repository: https://github.com/breuerfelix/chromedriver-py
  license: Apache-2.0 AND BSD-3-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - chromedriver-dist/LICENSE.chromedriver
    - chromedriver-dist/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.chromedriver
  summary: ChromeDriver binary for automated testing of web apps
  description: |
    chromedriver-py ships the ChromeDriver executable and exposes its
    location as chromedriver_py.binary_path, so Selenium and other WebDriver
    clients can find it without a separate download step or a PATH entry.
    The driver version tracks the Chrome release it was built for.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - killua156
